item.title: The Hindu: Delhi High Court says pending cases under Juvenile Justice Act must go to Children’s Courts
item.description: A Bench of Justice Navin Chawla and Justice Arun Bhardwaj passed the ruling on November 23 while answering two legal questions referred to it by an Additional Sessions Judge at Saket Courts
